channel.description: Theo is a software dev, AI nerd, TypeScript sympathizer, creator of T3 Chat and the T3 Stack.

title: How I parsed billions of rows for every user in 2 seconds
description:
I put way too much time into figuring out how to use Convex and Posthog to make the T3 Chat wrapped. Trust me, it was a lot harder then you think...

Thank you WorkOS for sponsoring! Check them out at: https://soydev.link/workos

Oh and use code WRAPPED for 1 month of T3 Chat for just $1: https://soydev.link/chat

Want to sponsor a video? Learn more here: https://soydev.link/sponsor-me

Check out my Twitch, Twitter, Discord more at https://t3.gg
